subject: Request: CSA CAIQ - annotated control assertions + log sample access
messages:
From: Alice Monroe <alice@peregrinefinancial.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@peregrinefinancial.com
Date: 2026-08-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ — annotated assertions + log sample request

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Peregrine's InfoSec team has a few follow-up asks to close our CSA review:

1) Can you provide an annotated CAIQ where Redwood marks which controls are "in-scope" for the hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private deployments and any compensating controls? A single spreadsheet with a short rationale per control would be ideal.

2) We need a 48-hour sample of request-level telemetry (redacted) showing token-level latency and request IDs for a narrow time window. Our auditors want to validate logging and retention pipelines. We'll need an NDA before accepting raw logs.

3) Any guidance on which controls map to SOC 2 evidence you've already produced would help speed review.

Can you confirm owner, ETA, and whether you can provide a DocuSign link for the NDA? Procurement is copied for timing.

Thanks,
Alice Monroe
Security Assessment Lead
Peregrine Financial

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Monroe <alice@peregrinefinancial.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@peregrinefinancial.com
Date: 2026-08-10T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ — annotated assertions + log sample request

Alice — thank you, got it. Looping in Soojin (Security) and Marissa (Customer Success) to coordinate the artifacts and DocuSign. High-level plan below; will follow up with timeline and attachments.

Plan / owners:
- Annotated CAIQ spreadsheet (hosted / dedicated / private split + short rationale): Soojin + Ben — deliver v1 within 48 hours.
- Telemetry sample (48-hour slice, redacted): Marissa to prepare access plan; we will only share after NDA is signed.
- SOC 2 mapping notes: Ben will extract the relevant SOC 2 artifact references and include Doc links in the CAIQ workbook.

Marissa — can you prepare the DocuSign NDA and a readme that explains how the log sample is redacted and which fields are removed? Ben / Soojin — please keep the rationale concise (1-2 lines per control) and annotate the spreadsheet cells rather than a separate doc.

Alice — ETA estimate: spreadsheet + mapping in 48 hours; DocuSign link within 4 hours; redacted log sample immediately after NDA signed, target 3 business days to stage and transfer.

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-11T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: RE: CAIQ — annotated assertions + log sample request

Team — quick updates on the annotated CAIQ:

- Scope approach: I'll add a column for 'deployment applicability' with values {Hosted, Dedicated, Private, All}. For controls where we rely on customer configuration (e.g., network ACLs on Private), I'll mark as "customer responsibility" and add a short note pointing to our deployment guide section.
- Compensating controls: I'll flag when we use runtime isolation, VPC peering, or KMS + HSM as mitigation and reference the artifact (e.g., HSM-rotation.pdf).
- SOC 2 cross-ref: Ben — please paste the SOC 2 artifact IDs into the "SOC2_ref" column so external reviewers can jump to the right evidence.

Attachments I'll prepare for v1: redwood_csa_annotated_answers_v1.xlsx (inline annotations), a short narrative (150-200 words) explaining our scoping assumptions, and a list of 3 example artifacts (with internal links).

Ben — flag any controls you think need more than a 1-2 line rationale.

Soojin
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Monroe <alice@peregrinefinancial.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-12T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: CAIQ — annotated assertions + log sample request

Alice — thanks, we just sent the DocuSign NDA link to your procurement inbox (link above). Once executed, we'll upload the redacted 48-hour telemetry slice to a secure SFTP and provide a short readme describing the redaction steps.

Preview of items you'll receive after NDA: 
- redwood_csa_annotated_answers_v1.xlsx (control applicability + SOC2_ref column)
- sample-log-snippet.kv.txt (two anonymized request rows, request_id hashed, timestamp, latency_ms, model_version)
- docsign-nda-peregrine.pdf (signed copy attached to transfer package)

If you'd like a quick review call when you get the artifacts, Jordan and Soojin are happy to join.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success
Redwood Inference

----
Attachments referenced: redwood_csa_annotated_answers_v1.xlsx, docsign-nda-peregrine.pdf, sample-log-snippet.kv.txt
